_how_to_add: Add one object per product, in the order they should appear. platform 'payhip' shows an on page Buy button (needs payhip_code, the part after payhip.com/b/). platform 'etsy' shows 'Buy on Etsy' linking to url. image lives in site/img (portrait, about 560 wide). featured true puts it on the home page. The home page shows big covers for 2 featured products and switches to a swipe row at 3 or more.
